description: Bar-level structure cases shared by test_smart_mix_structure.py and tools/crate-cli/tests/smart_mix_structure.rs. Inputs: a grid of 4-beat bars from firstBeatMs, RMS and band frames holding each bar's level (see _bar_level_inputs). gridTrusted is the analyzer's trust in its beat grid. Expected values come from app/crate/smart_mix/structure.py.
